verdict.rationale: Latham documents an Executive Compensation, Employment & Benefits practice that handles "employment issues," which is the firm's own employment practice. Nothing in the evidence names hiring paperwork, and the LathamDrive document generator covers incorporation documents only, so this is minimal, glancing support. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of preparing offer letters, employment agreements, and invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements; hiring-document templates or generator coverage; independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm prepares hiring paperwork — offer letters, employment agreements, and invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements — as part of a documented employment practice

citations.quote: we handle the most challenging compensation, employee benefits, and employment issues facing businesses today.
